🇺🇸 A Russian drone struck a school in Kyiv on Oct. 1 during another wave of aerial attacks on the Ukrainian capital; no casualties were reported because children and staff were sheltering at the time. The same day, Russian drones also hit an important bridge over the Dnipro River, disrupting transit across the city, part of what officials described as a continuing campaign of bombardment against Ukraine.

El mismo día, drones rusos también alcanzaron un importante puente sobre el río Dniéper, interrumpiendo el tránsito en la ciudad, en lo que las autoridades describieron como una campaña continua de bombardeo contra Ucrania.
